page.overview:
What is Pnath?

Pnath is a ficitonal region or city briefly mentioned as having been conquered by the city of Sarnath in H. P. Lovecraft's short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath". On the night of Sarnath's destruction, the king Nargis-Hei and his nobles were in the banquet hall of the royal palace, getting drunk on "ancient wine from the vaults of conquered Pnath".

By the time of Randolph Carter's visits to the Dreamlands, the vale of Pnath is a shunned area inhabited by the mysterious dholes. The floor is covered by half-eaten bones, as the Ghouls of the waking world use Pnath as a dumping ground to cast away "the refuse of their feastings", thrown from the edge of a crag that looms over the vale. Nodens' night-gaunt servants "flop unendingly in the dark betwixt the Vale of Pnath and the passes to the outer world". Any intruders found on Mt. Ngranek are captured by the night-gaunts and taken to the vale of Pnath to be left to their own devices. (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath)
